spec: DACS-5 v0.4 §10.5.1 RSV-1..RSV-4; settlement-verified types; consumes existing DACS-4 rules
decisionModel: accept admits the job; reject and indeterminate both exclude it without fault
inputModel: one authoritative bundle projection after cross-copy settlementEvidence reference-multiset agreement; every case uses an authenticated Agreement price of 5 DEM; evidencePhase defaults to the DACS-4 §9.7 PaymentPhaseType pay-dem for non-empty inputs, and only exact membership in that closed type can establish payment volume; evidence outcome defaults to success; authorityDisposition is the independent transaction/authority resolution result; mismatch is evaluated only when authorityDisposition is verified and names the sole semantic contradiction; mismatchIndex selects the zero-based member when present; null then means all semantic checks match

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-exact-pass
vectors.note: one fully verified presented settlement remains eligible and contributes one completion plus the Agreement price

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-amount-reject
vectors.note: resolved transaction amount contradicts the authenticated Agreement amount

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-payer-reject
vectors.note: resolved transaction payer contradicts the authenticated payer authority

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-payee-reject
vectors.note: resolved recipient or destination contradicts independent payee authority

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-session-reject
vectors.note: authenticated session authority contradicts the evidence job binding

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-phase-reject
vectors.note: authenticated executed-phase authority contradicts the evidence phase index

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-rail-reject
vectors.note: independently resolved rail, asset, or network authority contradicts the evidence

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-finality-reject
vectors.note: resolved rail finality is absent or below the pinned requirement

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-transaction-reject
vectors.note: independent transaction resolution deterministically rejects the presented evidence

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-authority-indeterminate
vectors.note: unavailable independent authority excludes the job without becoming success or fault

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-invalid-failed-outcome
vectors.note: invalid evidence on a failing bundle excludes the job from denominators and creates no fault

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-multi-entry-one-invalid
vectors.note: one amount contradiction rejects the whole otherwise verified two-reference multiset

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-empty-presented-multiset
vectors.note: the presented-evidence guard is vacuously verified, but no verified payment record means no volume or transaction count

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-delivery-only
vectors.note: verified delivery evidence admits non-volume reputation but is not a verified payment and contributes no volume

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-out-of-set-pay-prefix-non-volume
vectors.note: an otherwise-admitted candidate projection with an invented pay-* phase is not a DACS-4 PaymentPhaseType and cannot establish transacted volume

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-failed-payment-non-volume
vectors.note: a verified payment-phase failure does not establish transacted value

vectors.name: reputation-settlement-semantic-two-valid-payments-count-job-once
vectors.note: two verified successful payment references admit one job and count its Agreement price once, not once per evidence record
